instruction: ROOT CAUSE FIXED: fast-battle set battling@0x64F83C=1 on encounter but cleared g_fb.active ONLY on 'BU' (server forced-exit, never on normal end) -> battling stuck -> fast-encounter (gated battling==0) dies after 1 battle -> no more encounters. FIX (F0 port of launcher tcpserver.cpp case 'C' 14224-14278 isEnemyAllDead->setBattleEnd): fbParseBC now clears g_fb.active when all enemies dead. PS1 already replaced with fixed version. Step0 kill SA93Client + archive C:/zmffk/*diag*.log to archive-pre186. Build (verify FastBattleConclude marker + here-string/guard/g++). Config FastBattle=true AutoBattle=false FastAutoWalk=true AutoWalk=false Boost=14 (both default.json). Launch ONE via '석기 실행'(1443,674), record RUN_SINCE_ISO. Observe 90s; during battle open launcher F5->'배틀 상황', save cycle186-battlestatus.png. Run assert-fastbattle186.ps1 (env RUN_SINCE_ISO). Report EN count(>=3?), fastenc max cnt, fn1/fn4909D0, FBCHAN, exp-result(INFO), sa.dmp fresh?, assert exit, screenshot. No commit.
notes: 빠른전투 조우끊김 근본수정(적전멸→전투종료 이식). 성공기준: 연속조우(EN>=3)+빠른조우 지속(cnt>=10)+fn1/무fn4909D0(캐릭터정지)+FBCHAN fb=1 ab=0+무크래시. 배틀상황 스크린샷 유닛표시 육안판정용. exp-result는 INFO(별도 후속). 보고 한국어.
